title: Set Up: Sleep, Travel or Stay?

scenes.tts: Draw or print ten animal cards, like a hummingbird, groundhog and deer. Lay out three sheets: Travel, Rest, and Stay and change. Find a window with a view of trees or the sky.

items.text: Sheets: Travel, Rest, Stay and change

scenes.narration: Draw or print ten animal cards, like a hummingbird, groundhog and deer. Lay out three sheets: Travel, Rest, and Stay and change. Find a window with a view of trees or the sky.

scenes.tts: Ask your child to sort the cards with no help, and to say how they decided. Then check each animal together, and move cards as they learn.
scenes.narration: Ask your child to sort the cards with no help, and to say how they decided. Then check each animal together, and move cards as they learn.

scenes.tts: Then sit at the window for fifteen minutes and count the birds you see. The count depends on the season. An empty yard is a result too.

items.text: An empty yard is a result

scenes.narration: Then sit at the window for fifteen minutes and count the birds you see. The count depends on the season. An empty yard is a result too.

scenes.tts: Stay with your child for the whole activity. Nobody touches a wild animal, alive or dead. Never touch a bat, even one that seems asleep or hurt.

items.text: Never touch wild animals or bats

scenes.narration: Stay with your child for the whole activity. Nobody touches a wild animal, alive or dead. Never touch a bat, even one that seems asleep or hurt.
